page.overview:
What is Bitemark?

The Bitemark was a starship that the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk purchased during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Soon after he acquired it, the vessel was destroyed along with Bossk's favorite cantina during an explosive blasterfight between the bounty hunter and the fugitive smugglers Chewbacca and Han Solo on the Jurzan spaceport, after which the pair narrowly escaped Bossk. In 3 ABY, Bossk thought of the destroyed vessel when the Empire contacted him about a new bounty on Chewbacca and Solo, the former of whom had become the bane of his career.

The Bitemark was mentioned in "Tooth and Claw," a short story written by Michael Kogge and published in the From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back anthology in 2020.
